summary: The Backrooms: Level 0 is a multiplayer survival game spanning the yellow maze, the Habitable Zone, utility halls and the Electrical Station. Shared player behaviors own survival, combat, social interactions and progression, while each place simulation builds and maintains its own world; player state persists across places and NPCs carry individual relationships, gear and behavior state.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze and hub; generated maze plus authored cells, loot and sim-managed smilers/lurkers; authored cells include repeated lighting and local variants.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone and M.E.G. camp; sim manages environment, camp agents, supplies and encounters including hounds and skin-stealers.
places/level2 (3D) - Abandoned Utility Halls and Survivor camp; seeded halls/rooms, supplies, NPCs and the Level 3 threshold.
places/level3 (3D) - Electrical Station and Base Gamma; seeded maze, hazards, loot, hound brigades, deathmoth swarms and station detail geometry; x0z0.scene contains the gate photo assembly.
places/debug (3D) - isolated combat and loot test room; authored cells hold weapon/item stations, enemy pens and test stands, including a temporary hound manager test.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry and default main place; declares camera, player, input actions (including crouch/talk/shop) and HUD wiring.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain: locomotion, player, interact, talk, build, noclip, stats, critter.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - look camera with yaw/pitch and smoothed eye-height adjustment while crouching.
places/main/sim.js, places/level1/sim.js, places/level2/sim.js, places/level3/sim.js, places/debug/sim.js - per-place cadence/tick roots for local setup and simulation.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells - place config and authored placements; main, level1 and debug contain authored cell sets, and level3 adds a gate-photo scene.
scripts/ui.js + scripts/loot-ui.js, talk-ui.js, build-ui.js, stats-ui.js and noclip-ui.js - HUD composition and action routing for survival, social, loot, build and stats panels.
shared: scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml; scripts/lib/level1.js and level2.js with their data - per-level grids/layouts reused by simulation, geometry and gameplay.
scripts/lib/level3.js + scripts/lib/data/level3.yml + scripts/lib/maze3path.js - deterministic Electrical Station grid, zone/opening data and open-edge routes for geometry, sim, player and creatures.
scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/lib/weapons.js; weapon-look.js, weapon-prof.js and weapon-geo.js - weapon definitions and fitted variants shared by pickups, viewmodels and NPCs.
scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/loot3.js - shared token vocabulary and general loot, with Level 3-specific tables, pages, garments and weapons.
scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml; scripts/lib/stats.js - worn-slot/armor helpers and HALOGEN derivations reused by player, NPC combat, loot and UI.
scripts/lib/breakables.js + breakables.yml - damage, harvest, rubble and Level 0 wall synchronization used by player attacks and main simulation.

scripts/lib/npc-talk.js + scripts/lib/data/talk.yml and shops.yml - dialogue policy/model prompt parsing, rolls, NPC voice/name and trader stock/pricing helpers, called by scripts/talk.js and talk-ui.js.
scripts/critter2-geo.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - shared NPC avatar and movement/combat/talk/death behavior for M.E.G., Survivors and Gamma agents.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js, places/level1/sim.js, places/level2/sim.js, places/level3/sim.js and places/debug/sim.js - cadence and tick; place simulations own local setup/ticking.
scripts/lib/level3.js - grid/constants, cell/zone queries, openings, blocks/hazards and exits; scripts/lib/maze3path.js - stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/lib/breakables.js - strike, damageEntity, damageWall, rollDrops, spawnRubble, syncLevel0 and material/tool helpers.
scripts/build.js - onInput, update; scripts/build-ui.js - buildUi; scripts/ui.js - default render and plyUpload.
scripts/lib/loot3.js - rollWeaponL3, rollTableL3, rollItemL3, spawnCrateL3; scripts/deathmoths.js - update.
scripts/player.js - survival/combat/token and reload APIs; scripts/interact.js - openLoot, talk, onInput, update; scripts/talk.js - heard, onInput, update.
scripts/lib/items.js - itemsOf, tokenOf, describe; scripts/lib/clothes.js and scripts/lib/stats.js - apparel and HALOGEN helpers; scripts/stats-ui.js - statsUi.
scripts/lib/furniture.js - sizeOf, pickKind, spawnFurniture, wallSpot0/1/3; scripts/stealers.js and scripts/hounds.js - update.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state owns level/XP, health/survival, visited cells/zones, kills/deaths, equipment/inventory/ammo/condition, clothes, compass and Level 3 consumable/page fields; crouch and detect are also player state.
scripts/stats.js - player.state owns HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version, sheetOpen and target; initializes/migrates the sheet and spends points.
scripts/build.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.scrap and build/buildRot/buildLast selection; session holds preview ghost and forward direction.

scripts/interact.js - player focus, loot menu, notices and interaction; NPCs own pockets/picked plus per-player warned and angry state, containers own item lists/lock/scavenged state, and looted bodies' look drives worn clothing.
scripts/talk.js - player state holds talkWith, shopOpen, talks, subtitle and busy/mood fields; NPC state holds rapport, line/talk target, follow, per-player anger/discount/gift and trader stock.
scripts/critter.js - player.state.look owns appearance/worn slots; avatar scratch is local/session state.
Place simulations - place.state owns seed flags and local refill/respawn/hazard schedules; Level 3 also tracks generators, line output and actor managers.
Creature/NPC entity state - smilers, lurkers, hounds, stealers, deathmoths and meg-agent own health/death, rolled stats, drops and behavior flags; movement/path scratch is session-local.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js chain: locomotion reads prior movement; player owns movement/survival/combat; interact handles use; talk handles dialogue/shop; then build, noclip, stats and critter behaviors.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js owns presented yaw/pitch and crouched eye height; player/enemy gaze and targeting consume camera direction/state.
Level 0 exit in scripts/player.js → Level 1; later thresholds connect Level 1 to 2 and Level 2 to 3; Level 3 BACK door returns to Level 2 via scripts/level-door.js.

interact.js focus/E on living NPC → player.state.talkWith; scripts/talk-ui.js sends typed text/actions through talk/talkdo/shop inputs to scripts/talk.js; talk.js submits llm:chat and its heard handler validates reply/checks before rapport changes.
talk.js writes NPC state.line and player subtitle → scripts/talk-ui.js / scripts/ui.js; NPC voice is emitted nearby; shop actions update almond water, inventory and NPC stock.

interact.js crouched E near NPC → Sneak roll and NPC pockets → player.js takeToken/player inventory; any caught attempt warns and shoves once, repeat caught theft turns that NPC hostile; facing/detection lower the odds.
interact loot of a body → player inventory and scripts/interact.js strips removed clothing from the body's look/primitive params; stats/clothes helpers resolve NPC worn gear and armor.
place simulations and enemy deaths → scripts/lib/loot.js or loot3.js → weapon/clothing/item tokens → floor entities or searchable containers.

player.js attack → scripts/lib/breakables.js → entity hp or Level 0 wall hp/broken keys; rubble becomes containers and main/sim syncs wall geometry; BUILD similarly spends scrap and places breakable pieces.

scripts/lib/level3.js and level3 data → places/level3/sim.js geometry, details, checkpoints and hazards; sim starts hound/deathmoth managers and spawns station actors; maze3path routes creatures across open edges, while hounds.js applies the shared hound mesh and combat behavior across levels.
Level 3 loot3 → page/weapon/item tokens → player.js takeToken; UI renders pages; firesalt changes melee damage and stun_baton writes hound stunUntil.
scripts/player.js useCompass → scripts/lib/compass.js chooses place exits and writes compassRead → scripts/ui.js timed bearing/readout; player death also clears local NPC angry/warned/fresh grudges.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* - authored fluorescent fixtures and red-zone variants; selected cell also owns flicker-wall markings, sound and local flicker/light state.

scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - Level 0 pack managers with distinct gaze/light/sanity reactions; lurkers use the uploaded animated mesh, spawned at scale 1.23 (2.4 m), including the debug test spawn.

scripts/hounds.js + hound-geo.js - shared Level 1/2/3 hound AI with the rigged hound-v2 mesh; safe zones and grids vary by place, while Level 3 brigades use maze routing and stun state. Legacy coded geometry is swapped out on manager ticks.
scripts/stealers.js + stealer-geo.js - Level 1 skin-stealer behavior swaps legacy rows to the rigged mesh; disguise/creature/shed parts and reveal animation vary with its skin-to-hunt phase.
scripts/meg-agent.js + scripts/critter2-geo.js - common NPC behavior/avatar varies by species/look, role, voice, weapon and place; used by M.E.G., Survivors and Gamma agents.
scripts/lib/weapons.js + weapon-look.js + weapon-prof.js + weapon-geo.js + viewmodel-geo.js - weapon kinds reuse fitted bodies with variant stats/tint/overlays and viewmodel framing.
scripts/build-geo.js + breakables.yml - built structures, Level 0 office furniture, rubble and breakable props share geometry/crack stages while material, dimensions, hp and harvest outcomes vary.
scripts/deathmoths.js + templates/deathmoths.js - one Level 3 manager steers multiple swarms; each uses three rigged moth models and clips, while swarms vary by home and target.
probableOrphans: scripts/l2-door.js - exports a door-leaf swing animation, but no current tree/package reference to the script is visible.
scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - no active place uses it; place terrain is off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/reed.js - no active terrain layers or placed references are visible; terrain is off.
scripts/lib/furniture.js - no active place simulation calls its furniture-spawn helpers; Level 2 still has its separate container path.
migrationNotes: Grid contracts differ: Level 0 is 56×56 at 4 m with hub cells 26–29; Level 1 is 30×30 at 8 m; Level 2 is 24×24 at 5 m; Level 3 is 26×26 at 4 m. Keep geometry, zones, exits and routes aligned to each grid.

Player behavior order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js, then interact.js, talk.js, build.js, noclip.js, stats.js and critter.js; locomotion reads movement before player control writes velocity.
Weapon ids remain kind or kind~variant across inventory, condition, magazines and entities; use baseOf only where base-kind framing/behavior is intended.

Building scrap is a per-kind player.state.scrap object, unlike comma-separated inventory/container tokens; breakables need tag plus state.mat/hp/maxHp, and Level 0 wall hp/broken state is separate place.state data.
Level-specific zone keys are prefixed l1_/l2_/l3_; Level 3 generation is seeded from level3.yml, Gamma is safe, and LIFT remains a freight-elevator/sign rather than an implemented Level 4 crossing.

HALOGEN attributes/skills and apparel/pages use their existing state/token encodings; hounds and stealers replace legacy primitive bodies with rigged models, deathmoths are three child models per swarm, and furniture faces out from a wall while retaining interact.js's container tag/state.items/name/lock contract.
